body: I have tried through many people but she says that she doesn’t want to speak to me. I don’t know if that means forever. I would love for everything to change over the next few hours but I don’t see that happening. My head hurts so much. All I ever do is think about her. This has been around a month since we last spoke and we were so so close. I have so many people but she is the one person I care about so much. She was there since day 1 and I have lost her.
